about_the_game:
hey. want to start a cult?

cozycult is a satirical idle-roguelite where you run a cult from your phone through social media.

this demo gives you a full slice of the core loop, framed by a glowing battery timer that slowly drains to mark the end of each run.

buy apps. swipe your way to followers. ascend for bigger, faster gains. then start again with permanent upgrades, sillier strategies, and fully automated pipelines… until the battery fades out.

what you do

  • download apps like faithbook, instagrim, hypnoscroll, ubabble… and more

  • play small cozy minigames to grow your cult

  • collect faith, cash, followers, and divinity

  • unlock automation so the apps run themselves

  • ascend, earn cultivation points, and make the next run smoother

  • watch the phone battery tick down, ending each run with a natural pause

why it feels good

  • short runs framed by the battery timer, 5–10 minutes at a time

  • multiple paths to progress, with room for big swings

  • cozy humor and light satire, never too serious

  • a natural stopping point that leaves you wanting one more run

cozy. goofy. incremental. just let the numbers climb.
